description: budget-close (see main.zhang): the months a budget is closed in, the postings it takes before and after its close, a date-only close and one at a time, a second close, money moved out after the close, and a definition again.

requests.bql: SELECT name FROM #budgets WHERE date = 2024-02-01 AND NOT closed
SELECT name FROM #budgets WHERE date = 2024-03-01 AND NOT closed

known_issues.round_trip.beancount: KNOWN-ISSUE: a budget directive with a time is written to beancount with its date and time (`2024-02-15 18:00:00 custom "budget-close" "Fun"`), which zhang's beancount parser cannot read, so the round trip does not load, and which bean-check 3.2.3 rejects (`syntax error, unexpected NUMBER`); other directives move their time into a `time` metadata entry (extensions/beancount/src/lib.rs:163-169)
known_issues.errors: KNOWN-ISSUE: DefineDuplicatedBudget has no metas, so it does not name the budget, unlike every other budget error (zhang-core/src/process/budget.rs:15)
